articles.title: Artemis II Is About to Launch. What Investors Need to Know.
articles.mainIdea: Artemis II Is About to Launch. What Investors Need to Know.
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Artemis II Is About to Launch. What Investors Need to Know.. America is about to do something great: Send astronauts around the moon on a giant rocket that is taller than the Statue of Liberty. The sheer scale of space and what’s being attempted makes tuning in to NASA’s Artemis II mission worthwhile. The Artemis group of missions aims to return Americans to the lunar surface and establish a permanent presence on the Moon. Related tickers mentioned: BA, LMT, RKLB, SPAX.PVT, ^DJI, ^GSPC.
